StackChan GPT-Live CoreS3 build 2bec51b
ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, DIO, 80 MHz
Live continuity: Realtime input remains active while responses play.
Delegation: economical GPT-5.6 Terra reasoning with on-demand web search.
Boot behavior: AI.AGENT opens through Launcher and starts GPT-Live automatically.
Glass2: Port A shows dummy "Grok 73%"; missing hardware remains non-fatal.

Install the flasher only (ESP-IDF is not required):
  python3 -m pip install 'esptool==4.12.0'

Recommended single merged image (run from this directory):
  python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodemXXXX --baud 460800 --before default_reset --after hard_reset write_flash --flash_mode dio --flash_freq 80m --flash_size 16MB 0x0 stackchan-gpt-live-cores3-merged.bin

NVS-preserving app-only update:
  python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodemXXXX --baud 460800 --before default_reset --after hard_reset write_flash --flash_mode dio --flash_freq 80m --flash_size 16MB 0x20000 stack-chan.bin

Equivalent individual images:
  python3 -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodemXXXX --baud 460800 --before default_reset --after hard_reset write_flash --flash_mode dio --flash_freq 80m --flash_size 16MB 0x0 bootloader.bin 0x8000 partition-table.bin 0xd000 ota_data_initial.bin 0x20000 stack-chan.bin 0xa00000 generated_assets.bin

No file contains an OpenAI key or other secret. The merged image spans the NVS
address range with erased (0xFF) bytes, so flashing it resets NVS, Wi-Fi, and
settings. Use the individual-image command to preserve existing NVS. Running
erase_flash also removes NVS and requires key provisioning plus Wi-Fi setup.
